title: Absorb one heavy slice by the factor-7 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

One heavy slice fits the factor-7 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `7 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`,

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}.
```

Seven times the eighths is `56 (E + C p)`. The gate gives `560 g L = 80 · 7 g L ≤ 80 p`, so that multiple is at most `80 p + 56 - 28 p^2`. The polynomial `28 p^2 - 80 p - 112` equals `109456` at `p = 64` and increases by `56 p - 52`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 98` and `g = 2`, `7 g L = 98 ≤ 98` while `8 g L = 112 > 98`, and the exponent is `-9463`. The factor-8 line `80 g L ≤ 10 p` fails there (`1120 > 980`). This `7` multiplies `g L`. The coefficient-9 monomials in #4495 still use `16 g L ≤ p`, because `9 > 8`. At `p = 2` and `g = 1` the factor-7 hypothesis fails, and `e < 3` puts the slice above `1`.

The `g` copies under this gate stay open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`. This answers the open question of #4661. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_SEVEN_GATE` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T14:42:11Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetch, reread at 2026-10-22T14:43:15Z, was unchanged, and the pinned blobs match. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
